number here is missed, so these are the contract — not a log of what the
Scope: the LOCAL dev stack (`pnpm dev`) against the default fixture
(66 files, 31,102 cells). They are stall ceilings, not stopwatch targets:
generous enough that a slower supported machine passes, tight enough that
a path going file-proportional fails. Do not tighten them to the fastest
machine in the room — AGENTS.md rule 15.
These values are the OPENING ceilings, set from the 2026-10-10 scaling
audit's intent rather than from a measured baseline. Re-baseline them on
the first real run: `pnpm perf:measure --suggest-budgets` prints this file
with the run's numbers plus headroom. Record in the commit message which
machine and which fixture size produced them.
